notes.title: Get Chief Emoji Officer in the Steam Summer Sale!
notes.content:
Bodeville is participating in our very first Steam Sale! It's an incredible milestone for us, and we're excited to offer Chief Emoji Officer for 30% off for anyone who hasn't gotten a chance to spam Karen with an 🍆 yet.

When we started making games together, we dreamed of creating narrative experiences that would make players think. We poured countless hours, dedication, creativity, and testing into this first game, aiming to craft something out of the ordinary.

Just want to thank everyone for following along in our journey. Your support, reviews, feedback mean a lot, and we're excited to continue making kooky and innovative experiences for you in the future.

Good luck getting the golden eggplant,
Alexia & Bo

notes.title: Chief Emoji Officer 1.1 update, release notes
notes.content:
CEO 1.1 is here! We made a couple updates to improve replayability in addition to bug fixes. Thanks for playing!

- Adds an option to speed up any dialogue that has already been seen on previously played chapters.
- Moves layoffs to end of chapters rather than the beginning of the next chapter.
- Unity update which should fix occasional crashing.
- A tiny bugfix to actually make your Pant job title "CEO" at the end (whoops!)
- A few dialogue fixes

notes.title: Chief Emoji Officer is launched!!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43704601/7779cb444a630ab6dcc8132910e8a35fe1002384.png[/img]

Chief Emoji Officer launches today!!

You're a new hire to Redify, a startup that loves changing the world! It's up to you to turn the company around and climb to the executive level by making decisions for the company. Work with a variety of unique co-workers and respond to their messages to navigate corporate politics in this unique twist on a text adventure. 

If you enjoy Chief Emoji Officer, please help us out and write a review! One of the biggest challenges of a new indie studio in a competitive field is getting noticed, and reviews go a long way.

Thank you for following us along the journey! We hope you enjoy the game and get a few good laughs. We certainly had fun writing it.

Alexia and Bo
